subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial intake, compact evidence plan, and bridge-letter ask
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <h.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial intake, compact evidence plan, and bridge-letter ask

Hi Helen,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to kick off the assurance intake for Acme Analytics. To make this lightweight for your team, we propose a compact first-pass that covers the audit period and gives your security team what they typically need to onboard a SOC 2 Type II report.

Quick summary of asks (minimal first-share):
- Final SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) for the period Jan 1 — Dec 31, 2026 (if available) OR confirmation of audit period if different.
- Bridge letter (if you have one) that explains any control changes between the report date and today. If you don’t have one, we can share a short template.
- Evidence manifest: handful of artifacts to validate common controls (policy snapshots, a sample access log, IAM configuration screenshot, backup schedule entry). I attached a compact CSV manifest with examples.
- Preferred transfer method: secure SFTP, presigned S3, or DocuSign-backed secure portal (your choice).

Timeline we’re targeting:
- Initial package received: within 7 business days (by Jun 16)
- Follow-up clarifying asks: 1–2 business days after receipt

If it helps, attached is a short bridge-letter template and a compact evidence manifest (examples only). Suggested reply templates are below if you want to delegate internally — feel free to reply one-line and we’ll coordinate the rest.

One-line reply template (external teams often use this to delegate):
"+1 — forwarding to InfoSec (sec-team@acme) to collate the Type II report + sample artifacts. ETA next Thursday."

Notes on redaction: we only need example artifacts (sample lines from logs, blurred usernames if required) — full raw logs aren’t necessary for the initial intake.

Let me know which transfer option you prefer and whether the audit period above matches your report. Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call to unblock.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Security Program Lead
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, evidence_manifest_compact.csv

- We do have a Type II for period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and can share the PDF.
- We don’t currently issue formal bridge letters; InfoSec usually provides a short cover email that calls out any material control changes. I’ll confirm if we can produce a one-page bridge letter.

- For the compact manifest: can you confirm the minimum log window you need for a sample? 

I’m looping in our security mailbox (security@acme-analytics.com) to coordinate the artifact delivery. ETA for the initial package: Jun 15.

—Helen

Hi Acme security team — thanks Helen for looping in the inbox. Quick clarifications for the manifest and log sample: 

Minimum artifact guidance (compact intake):
- Audit report PDF (final signed report) — required.
- Bridge note (one-paragraph) — preferred but optional for the initial intake.
- Access control evidence: screenshot of IAM groups or a one-page export (CSV) showing group membership for 2–3 admin accounts.
- Logs: 7-day sample of auth logs (sample lines are fine; remove PII). If you can only provide 48–72 hours, that’s ok as a first pass — we'll flag follow-ups if needed.
- Backup proof: calendar entry or backup job run history screenshot for a representative week.
- Change control: one example PR/CR ticket showing review + approval.

Share mechanisms we can accept (in order of preference):
1) Pre-signed S3 link (preferred, short TTL)
2) Secure SFTP account (works)
3) Encrypted ZIP on DocuSign or secure portal

If you want, we can redact sensitive fields — we’ll sign an NDA / EULA supplement if required (we’ve done this with other customers). I’ll coordinate a short Dropbox of secure options after you confirm preference.

Kimberly / Rishi — I’ll need the HubSpot intake record updated once they confirm the transfer link (I’ll paste below a suggested intake note).

Suggested HubSpot note to paste into company record:
"Requested SOC 2 Type II report (period 2026-01-01 — 2026-12-31). Acme to deliver initial package via S3 presigned link by 2027-06-15. Received: report PDF, 7-day auth log sample, IAM screenshot, backup proof. Follow-ups anticipated: log rotation sample and PR/CR evidence."

Thanks,
Stephanie
